# TEZAUR 0.4.0

Local, citation-grounded thesis research assistant: ask your own library, get answers whose every `[n]` points at a real passage, and audit your draft's citations mechanically. Rust CLI + local web server + MCP + ~80 distribution/integration variants + Mesh peer-to-peer.

## Highlights
- Advanced PDF: tables (Markdown/CSV/JSON) and display equations with their numbers.
- `audit`, `refs`, `coverage`, `novelty`, `receipt`/`declare` (AI-use statement), `bib` export (RIS / CSL JSON / BibTeX).
- Local dictation (Whisper in the browser), Mesh P2P (federated search, pull, offline `.tzb` bundles).
- Package repositories on GitHub Pages (APT, RPM, Flatpak, F-Droid) installed in clean containers by CI.
- 13 short video tutorials with subtitles in en, ro, fr, it, es, pt, de, hu (generator in `scripts/tutorials/`; the rendered videos are not part of the repository).

## Security hardening in this release (adversarial review, see REVIEW.md round 0.4.6)
- CSRF guard on the token-less local server (cross-site `Origin` and `null` refused for state-changing requests).
- Zip-bomb caps for `.docx`/`.epub`/`.tzb`; peer answers capped at 64 MB; 180 s timeout on `pdftotext`.
- A panic in one request can no longer stop the server; `audit` now compares figures exactly (`3.71` ≠ `71.3`); crash-safe index save.

## Honest limits
- The model is yours (Ollama, Jan, LM Studio…); TEZAUR verifies citations mechanically, it does not prove claims.
- Server handles requests one at a time; page numbers of unpaginated sources (`.md`, `.txt`) cannot be checked.
- APT/RPM repositories are unsigned; the F-Droid key is generated per build. Store submissions (App Store, Google Play, Flathub, Snap Store, winget, Homebrew core) are not done.
- Subtitle translations are machine-written and not reviewed by native speakers; tutorials have no voice-over.

Binaries for Linux, macOS (arm64) and Windows plus a `.deb` and checksums are attached by the release workflow.

# TEZAUR 0.4.0 (română)

Asistent local de cercetare pentru teză, cu citări verificabile: întrebi propria bibliotecă, fiecare `[n]` trimite la un pasaj real, iar `audit` verifică mecanic citările din draft. Include PDF avansat (tabele, ecuații), Mesh P2P, depozite de pachete, 13 tutoriale video subtitrate în 8 limbi și întărire de securitate (CSRF, zip-bomb, timeout, izolarea panicilor, comparare exactă a cifrelor). Limitele sunt enumerate mai sus.
